scope: Track S synthetic known-generative only; no physical-RF, deployability or MB_VAR-superiority claim

power.rule: From the DEV pilot only: for every primary H1/CAL/testable-H2/applicable-H3 contrast, projected 95% half-width 1.96*se_dev*sqrt(n_dev/n) must be <= its margin (H1/CAL: log1.5-|dev|; H2: |DID_S0|/2; H3: |log ratio_S0|/2). n_confirm = 30 if all fit, else 60 (flag underpowered_at_max if 60 does not fit). HOLDOUT uses the first n_confirm ids of splits.S_field.HOLDOUT.
